_doc: Bloom nests (ADR-0055, NestDef): grown masses of Bloom in the deep woods. BloomNests builds a placed one (a region feature {"type": "nest", "def": id, "at": [x, z], "yaw": deg} or a placement from the encounter scatter) from its props (nest-local metres, +Z the mouth; pod: the Hollowed come out of it), puts its Bloom on the ground (a spot in the field: bloom radius m, strength 0..1), keeps seed.count Hollowed round it while the player is within seed.range (seed.sleepers lie in its roots, the rest wander; a killed one comes back from the pods after respawn_hours until it is burned), and burns: only fire hurts its core (a torch blow); at zero hp it burns for burn.seconds with a scream the Hollowed hear at burn.scream metres, its guards wake and come, then it is dead: loot (loot table, loot_rolls times), XP (burn_nest x xp), directive event burn_nest, and its Bloom fades over burn.fade_hours.

defs.name: Root Knot
defs.description: A young nest: a knot of pale roots no higher than a man, one pod beside it.

defs.name: Hollow Nest
defs.description: A cage of roots twice a man's height arched over a hollow, its heart pulsing inside, pods standing round it and the bones of the people it took in the felt.
